title: GSLiquidityDash
tagline: Manage your Gnosis Safe Pay Card effortlessly with our dashboard! View transactions, and automate liquidity management
description: My project is a Gnosis Safe Dashboard built to provide users with a seamless experience in managing their Gnosis Safe accounts. It allows users to view their transaction history, deploy contracts, and automate liquidity management. I used Tailwind CSS for styling, TypeScript for type safety, React for the frontend, Next.js for server-side rendering, and Solidity for smart contracts. Gnosis Safe and associated relay contracts were integrated to ensure secure and reliable interactions with the blockchain.
how_its_made:
I built our Gnosis Safe Dashboard using a combination of frontend and backend technologies. The frontend is developed with TypeScript, React, and Tailwind CSS, providing a responsive and visually appealing user interface. Next.js is utilized for server-side rendering and routing, enhancing performance and SEO.

On the backend, I leverage Solidity to create smart contracts for interacting with Gnosis Safe accounts and managing transactions. These contracts are deployed on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring security and decentralization. Additionally, I aim to integrate Gnosis Safe relay contracts to facilitate seamless communication between our dashboard and the blockchain.

A notable aspect of our project is the auto-liquidity management feature, which allows users to automatically manage their liquidity rather than relying solely on staking yields. This feature is implemented using smart contract logic and enhances user flexibility in managing their assets.

Overall, our project combines frontend and backend technologies with Gnosis Safe contracts to create a robust and user-friendly dashboard for decentralized finance management. Through careful integration and development, we aim to revolutionize the way users interact with their assets in the DeFi space.
